{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Live At Radio City Music Hall; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me who is performing, so I would pass.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Tom Petty connects naturally with my recent Benmont Tench listening; this is my first choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy country sound fits part of my listening, but I am choosing rock today.
ItemID: NA; Title: World Wide Rebel Songs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and classic rock than politically focused folk rock right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: High Hopes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Springsteen fits my interest in established rock artists, but I would prioritize the Petty album.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Fools, No Fun – 2 Track Bonus Version; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues and roots direction appeals, but I am not interested enough to choose another album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this compilation matches my interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Tour De Force: Live In London - Hammersmith Apollo; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my Clapton and Hendrix listening, though I would save this live set for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: All My Friends: Celebrating The Songs & Voice Of Gregg Allman; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Allman's bluesy Southern rock fits my interests, and the tribute performances make me curious enough to try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ryan Adams; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-rock songwriting could suit me, but my stronger interest today is Petty and Allman."}
